status_reason: Critic verdict MAJOR. Direction of effect contradicted by human tissue (Hh deficient/down in COPD epithelium; GLI1 required for AT2 proliferation, PMID 42399584) so SMO inhibition predicts harm. Cell context wrong in humans (adult HHIP epithelial, 4q31 enhancer Hedgehog-INDEPENDENT via SMAD3, PMID 38417378). Core 'ongoing not developmental' premise has no supporting experiment; best model places effect in alveologenesis with neonatal HHIP-Fc (PMID 40333979). SMO itself has zero genetic evidence for COPD. Novelty overstated: sub-claim N3 not N4 (TITLE_ABS 1 hit vs full text 10). Nominated cheap test not runnable (no HHIP lung cis-eQTL in GTEx v8).
statement: In adults, COPD risk from HHIP-expression-lowering alleles at 4q31 acts partly through ongoing mesenchymal Hedgehog activity; therefore SMO inhibition should be most protective against emphysema progression in HHIP risk-allele carriers.

queries.query: TITLE_ABS:(HHIP) AND TITLE_ABS:(vismodegib OR sonidegib) AND TITLE_ABS:(COPD OR emphysema)
(HHIP) AND (vismodegib OR sonidegib) AND (COPD OR emphysema)
cond=COPD OR emphysema; intr=vismodegib OR sonidegib OR smoothened

competing_explanations: 4q31 is a lung-growth/airway-geometry locus (dysanapsis, fewer/larger alveoli), with the height signal p<=1e-300 as the tell; adult HHIP acts via SMAD3/TGFb and epithelial wound-healing/EMT programmes that are Hedgehog-independent
graveyard_check: No SMO-inhibitor trial in COPD/emphysema anywhere; Hh inhibition for COPD already proposed in review PMID 36191777 (2022)
kill_criterion: HHIP instrument associates with baseline lung function but not FEV1 decline / emphysema progression => developmental, drop. NOTE: as written this is confounded with power; progression GWAS are underpowered, so a null is uninformative.
cheapest_test: Genotype-stratified GLI-target-gene readout in adult human lung mesenchyme vs epithelium (HLCA, LTRC, GSE47460 pseudobulk), plus a SMO/PTCH1/GLI2 cis-instrument drug-target MR

notes: Smoke-test hypothesis used to validate the pipeline. Killed by copd-critic on first pass. Its failure is now the worked example in discovery-methods.md s10. No fabricated citations found (all 5 dossier PMIDs real and unretracted).
